audience: equestrian stables and breeders who show their horses on a website with Equicty

useCases.title: List the horses marked public
useCases.text: List the horses the stable marked public for its website, with age, sex, studbook, colour and height. Filter by gender or language.

useCases.title: Review one horse's pedigree and media
useCases.text: Open one public horse by id. Read its three-generation pedigree, profile images, videos and pictures.

useCases.title: Draft a horse profile for the website
useCases.text: Collect the profile data of a public horse, such as age, colour and pedigree, to write its web page text.
